newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sasol plans 73 mln rand desalination plant.
newsitem.headline: Sasol plans 73 mln rand desalination plant.

text.p: Sasol Synthetic Fuels Ltd (SSF) is to build a 73 million rand desalination plant to purify and recover mine water from its Secunda mines, parent Sasol Ltd said on Monday.

It said in a statement the project, which is due for commissioning in mid-1997, would purify and recover six million litres of water a day at the mines, saving SSF at least 1.9 million rand a year in reduced raw water consumption.

Sasol said although the desalination plant could not be justified on economic grounds, it was necessary to reduce the impact on the environment, by preventing the pumping of mine water to river streams and dams.
A season of heavy rain in the Secunda area had led to a sharp increase in the volume of water which had to be pumped out of the mines since December last year.
The mines supply SSF with low-grade coal for processing into synthetic fuels and chemicals.
